# VAIG - Runtime Evaluation and Distrust Engine

> Canonical Role: Runtime evaluation, uncertainty assessment, evidence adequacy, and EvaluationReport issuance layer.

## Architectural Boundaries

- VAIG evaluates model output, actual state, and evidence adequacy.
- VAIG DOES NOT grant positive execution clearance (owned by REHT).
- VAIG DOES NOT enforce decisions (owned by RACS).
- VAIG DOES NOT execute actions (owned by Core).

## Canonical Invariants

1. Evaluation != Clearance
2. EvaluationReport != Execution Permit
